profile.headline: Trusted Engineering Leader | Agentic AI | Risk Compliance Technology | E-Discovery | Entrepreneur | Remote
profile.summary:
Accomplished Lead Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience enhancing operational efficiency, automating processes, and optimizing enterprise software solutions across diverse industries.  Seeking an Engineering Director, Manager or Staff Engineer level roles implementing Agentic AI Strategies to augment key business processes.

Productivity Achievements
• Enhanced developer efficiency 50% via CI/CD and K8s deployments with Harness and GitHub. 
• Improved efficiency by 30% by architecting an alert engine that exported alerts to Actimize. 
• Increased stakeholder productivity by 50% via automation while managing the overall service delivery and change control process of key deliverables essential to business operations. 

Cost Reduction Achievements 
• Reduced cost $5M+ annually for government operations by leveraging HP Fortify static analysis tools to identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across DLA applications. 
• Decreased operating costs $1.4M by optimizing Fraud Detection mechanisms within Business Online operations, improving risk identification, process efficiency, and platform effectiveness. 
• Streamlined onboarding and reduced implementation time by 15% by endorsing a universally trusted, industry-leading enterprise MCP Gateway to standardize integrations with Apigee. 

Automation and Performance Improvements 
• Achieved 95% automation coverage of global expense reviews by orchestrating delivery of an AI-driven ABC monitoring platform through collaboration and advanced process automation. 
• Boosted application performance 50% by architecting global thread-safe application settings singleton instances accessible for the ASP.NET pipeline, improving configuration efficiency. 
• Improved API throughput by 40% through effectively implementing horizontal scaling strategies using load balancing, reverse proxy architecture, and advanced firewall infrastructure.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, VP
positions.description:
As Tech Lead Manager of the Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABC) line of business, I provide technical leadership by overseeing the support, maintenance, and reliability of mission critical software solutions within the financial crimes line of business. Manage a team of 6 high performing software engineers to support proprietary software that is used to detect, prevent, and mitigate risk in regard to expense transaction monitoring of both US and NON-US government officials.

Key Accomplishments:

• Led a cross-functional team of engineers, architects, and compliance SMEs to deliver an AI-powered ABC monitoring platform, achieving 95% automation coverage for global expense reviews. 
  
• Architected a custom expense alert engine service layer that exported critical expense alerts to a third-party case management tool (Actimize), improving dispositioning efficiency metrics by 30% 
  
• Leveraged a standard CI/CD pipeline for application build and code orchestration, employing rolling-deployment K8s pipelines within Harness and GitHub Actions, which improved developer efficiency by 50%.
  
• Led the successful cloud modernization deliverables which included the successful migration of all ABC Components from Pivotal Cloud Foundry to OpenShift containers well in advance of committed target release timelines by 2 months.

positions.title: Application Systems Engineer V
positions.description:
Deliver high level technical direction and support of proprietary ASP.NET e-discovery applications for internal legal counsel and IT e-discovery service stakeholders.  Provide team supervisory support and task delegation in conjunction with the Application Development manager in support of new features added to the application. Aid with the interviewing and hiring of new development resources added to the team based on varying initiatives.

Key Accomplishments:

• Engineered a next‑generation E‑Discovery platform that automated Matter Data classification and dispositioning, cutting document review volumes by 40% and accelerating litigation and regulatory readiness across high‑complexity matters.

• Scaled E‑Discovery ingestion and processing infrastructure to support 10× growth in matter volume while maintaining sub‑second search latency

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provide technical leadership in the development and support of proprietary .NET applications for multiple external Xerox clients. Serve as a pinnacle resource in designing n-tier architectures and providing complex problem solving for the Xerox innovation group. Contribute to the analysis of all new enhancements with external stakeholders, third party vendors, and SBU resources. Build relationships with SBU leaders to generate further business and development opportunities. Provide guidance and mentoring to other development resources when applicable.

Key Accomplishments:

• Lead developer of a proprietary HR workflow application to streamline standard payroll and new hire guided workflows through automation using WPF and ASP.NET MVC. Application reduces standard call time metrics by 25%.
  
• Built high‑performance data ingestion pipelines that imported employee data from SuccessFactors ERP repositories, improving data accuracy and accelerating onboarding and case creation workflows.

• Designed and delivered a unified HR support interface that consolidated multiple subsystems into a single agent experience, reducing training time and attrition by 80% while improving first‑call resolution.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Devise custom ASP.NET solutions for the Federal Defense Logistics Agency. Maintain vital DLA proprietary applications serving multiple lines of business and stakeholders. Serve as a key technical resource to cultivate excellence by generating innovative ideas for proposed application enhancements. Advocate .NET software engineering best practices in terms of development, configuration management, and requirements traceability when applicable. Coordinate software release implementations with all dependent resources and external groups.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Enhanced and maintained mission critical ASP.NET web applications for the Online Banking infrastructure.  Serve as the primary technical resource for the business online banking application design and technical requirements analysis.  Developed software design deliverables such as class, ERD, and object responsibility diagrams that was loaded into the SDLC repository.  Manage software release implementations and standard enterprise change control processes.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description: Provide high-quality solutions that address the needs of the retail training application development team.  Perform custom ASP.NET web development within the Retail Training Learning Management System.  Architect the Retail Training course status and curriculum assignment tracking application.  Develop a custom training history section for each student assigned to a particular curriculum using ASP.NET user controls and master pages.  Manage deployments and change control processes pertaining to the retail training website.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description: Perform custom ASP.NET 2.0 development for the Sales Force Automation – Contact Management team.  Lead Developer for a highly anticipated enhancement by the Stakeholders allowing multiple contacts to be streamlined during a contract submission.  Collaborate with the business stakeholders to determine requirements needed for all Sales Force automation enhancements.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
